The '''Ur-Yuuzhan Vong''' were a [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Yuuzhan'tar]] in a [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|distant galaxy]]. Ur-Yuuzhan Yong lived as symbiotes with their homeworld and the species as a whole. Ur-Yuuzhan Yong were the ancestral species of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], which they devolved into after they were cut off from [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

==History==
The name was given to the species from which the modern [[Yuuzhan Vong]] evolved from and were the early beings that were completely connected to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The Ur-Yuuzhan Vong lived in symbiosis with one another and the species as a whole.<ref name=":0">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

However, when the Ur-Yuuzhan Vong became too proud of their individual accomplishments, their homeworld punished the species, it [[Sever Force/Legends|maimed them so that they were suddenly cut off from the Force]], because of their desire to [[Escalation|escalate]], after which they turned to violence. Modern Yuuzhan Vong religion attributed this to their deities namely [[Yun-Yuuzhan]] and that he had sacrificed his body to create the Yuuzhan Vong. Thus it was the gods and was not the Force that created them.<ref name=":0" />

In time, their religion became so twisted that they believed that the only way to return to their gods was further escalate themselves, resulting in their devotion to pain, sacrifice and [[Death/Legends|death]]. Pain was prized, since the torturous agony of their bodies being altered to be outside the Force was the one thing that the Yuuzhan Vong could remember of the long-lost time.<ref name=":0" />
